description: This file defines a class DatabaseConnection that manages connections to the jwql database or MAST service, including methods for initializing the connection, querying files associated with instruments, and handling database sessions. It is a core component for database interfacing within the jwql web application.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Facilitates connection and querying of the jwql database or MAST service, providing methods for initialization and data retrieval based on instrument.

methods.name: __init__(self, db_type, instrument=None)
methods.description: Initializes DatabaseConnection with specified database type ('SQL' or 'MAST') and optional instrument, choosing the appropriate setup method.

methods.name: init_SQL(self)
methods.description: Establishes a SQLAlchemy session with the jwql database, reflecting tables dynamically.

methods.name: init_MAST(self, instrument=None)
methods.description: Configures the MAST service string based on the specified instrument for querying.

methods.name: get_files_for_instrument(self, instrument)
methods.description: Retrieves file paths and filenames associated with the specified instrument from either SQL or MAST.
